name: local-agent-harness
description: Local Windows MCP server for targets and operations saved by the user.
long_description: Runs Local Agent Harness as a local stdio MCP server on Windows. Available tools depend on the current Windows user's saved Local Agent Harness settings and action policies. Some tools contact configured external services, run saved local tasks, or perform saved operations. Review the saved scope and approval policy before use.

tools.name: submit_setup_draft
tools.description: Submit a proposed setup for review in the local UI; it does not apply settings.

tools.name: registered_ssh_targets
tools.description: List saved SSH targets and their fixed permitted operations.

tools.name: run_ssh_operation
tools.description: Run a saved SSH operation under its saved approval policy.

tools.name: registered_targets
tools.description: List enabled service targets and their available actions.

tools.name: registered_service_bundles
tools.description: List saved service bundles and their available actions.

tools.name: registered_target_connection_test
tools.description: Send a bounded read-only request to a selected saved target and record the result locally.

tools.name: registered_python_tasks
tools.description: List enabled saved Python tasks.

tools.name: python_run_registered_task
tools.description: Run a saved Python task under its saved execution policy.

tools.name: github_repository
tools.description: Read the repository saved on a registered GitHub target.

tools.name: github_pull_request
tools.description: Read a pull request from a registered GitHub repository.

tools.name: harbor_repository_artifacts
tools.description: Read artifacts from the repository saved on a registered Harbor target.

tools.name: harbor_project_quota
tools.description: Read quota for the project saved on a registered Harbor target.

tools.name: dashboard_namespaces
tools.description: List namespaces visible to a registered Kubernetes Dashboard target.

tools.name: dashboard_deployment_status
tools.description: Read Deployment status for a registered service-bundle environment.

tools.name: dashboard_deployment_diagnosis
tools.description: Read Deployment status, related events, and Pod inventory for a registered environment.

tools.name: dashboard_deployment_events
tools.description: Read events for a Deployment mapped to a registered environment.

tools.name: dashboard_deployment_pods
tools.description: Read Pod status for a Deployment mapped to a registered environment.

tools.name: dashboard_deployment_pod_logs
tools.description: Read a bounded log window for a Pod and container in a registered Deployment.

tools.name: jenkins_registered_job
tools.description: Read the Jenkins job saved on a registered target.

tools.name: jenkins_registered_queue_item
tools.description: Read queue status for a registered Jenkins target.

tools.name: jenkins_registered_build_log
tools.description: Read a bounded build-log segment from a registered Jenkins target.

tools.name: jenkins_run_registered_job
tools.description: Run a Jenkins job saved on a registered target under its approval policy.
